meta.title: The silent gap
meta.question: Which gaps do customers feel but not say?
caveats: The gap is group-level (T04, All respondents, n = 319).
Answers are linked to a pair by concept, through the codes mapped to it — never by person: the open-ended answers carry no level or stakeholder type.
Codes are one coder's, checked blind on 200 answers (behaviour alpha 0.87; lexicon 0.72, usable with caution).
meta.provenance: Concept map Claude's (INFERRED), confirmed by Scott 2026-10-30. Answers VERBATIM.
